items.title: Dick Hyman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Don Miller honored me as their Musician of the Year

ctx.x: I’ve been told that at certain other festivals you’ve told some stories about some of the things that you’ve done during your career that make for an interesting tale. Do you have some things in your career that you maybe wouldn’t want to do again?
You are talking about a talk I gave last year when Don Miller honored me as their Musician of the Year. And I prepared a tape which I call “Sins of my Youth” which had a lot of very odd stuff on it.
Do you want to share some of that?
